sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the National Development Finance
Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd June, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the National Development Finance Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once,

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act XIII of 1973

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the National Development Finance
Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd June, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 2, Act XIII of 1973.--In the National
Develop ment Finance Corporation Act, 1973 (XIII of 1973), hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, in section 2, in clause (f ), after the brackets, figures
and words "(LVII of 1962)", the commas and words ", and includes
any other company or other body corporate sponsored, owned or controlled by the
Federal Government or a Provincial Government, whether directly or through a
com pany or corporation set up or, controlled by such Government, which the
Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, declare to be
a financial institution for the purposes of this Act" shall be added.

sections.shortTitle: National Development Finance Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 15, Act XIII of 1973

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the National Development Finance
Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd June, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
3. Amendment of section 15, Act XIII of 1973.--In the said Act, in
section 15,-
(a) after clause (b), the
following new clause shall be inserted namely :-
"(bb) to
promote, sponsor, from and get incorporated one or more companies having
amongst its or their objects the furtherance of the business and objects of the
Corporation;"; and
(b) for clause (c) the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(c) to
make loans and advances, and provide lease financing to eligible enterprises
and to financial institutions on short, medium and long=term basis, and to
provide assistance for working capital requirements;".

Amendment of section 17, Act XIII of 1973

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1983
NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the National Development Finance
Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd June, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
4. Amendment of section 17, Act XIII of 1973.--In the said Act, in
section 17,-
(a) for clause (a) the following
shall be substituted, namely :-
"(a) undertakings
which are wholly or partly owned by the Federal Government, a Provincial
Government or a local authority ;"; and
(b) after clause (b), the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(bb)
undertakings in the private sector, in particular those set up and established
in the less developed areas of Pakistan;".
